system.description: You shine with wholesome light, automatically inflicting 4 damage (no roll needed) on anyone who tries to touch you or strike you with a melee attack. While Righteous Cloak is active, bright light illuminates a short area around you if you wish. This ability lasts until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Enabler.
